title: Told user to pull before installer fix was merged

content.failure: After discovering the Grapher local-installer bug and preparing PR #30, the agent gave the user pull/install instructions without first verifying that PR #30 had been merged into main.
content.impact: The user was told to pull a fix that was not yet present on main, creating another broken update path and additional confusion immediately after the installer incident.
content.root_cause: The agent conflated prepared/open PR state with merged/deployable state and failed to gate user-facing update instructions on repository merge status.
content.remediation: Verify PR state, CI, and mergeability; merge PR #30 before giving pull instructions. Record this failure separately from the installer implementation bug.
content.prevention: Before telling a user to pull, update, install, or consume a repository change, explicitly verify that the referenced change exists on the target branch or published release. Prepared/open PR state is never equivalent to deployed state.
